| MAT-T121 | 2026-11-07 | fix | closed | HIGH PRIORITY golden rule enforcement: agents and their subagents keep running full test suites and bot soaks on their own (20-25 min each, per change), idling the 5-hour window (every CLI is supposed to reach 98% utilization) despite AGENTS.md 'Tests run only when the user says so'. Owner 2026-11-07: 'you can't sit around idle for half an hour to run entire test suites... its such a waste of resources to let something retest every little change 100s or 1000s of times in a 5hr period, this needs to be a GOLDEN RULE that everything follows'. Fix: (1) a PreToolUse hook in shared/hooks, wired for every CLI via install-hooks, refusing test-runner commands (dotnet test, pytest, npm/yarn test, vitest/jest, cargo test, ctest, tools/test.ps1, soak/balance runners) unless the user's own turn asked for tests (/test, /run tests), subagents included; (2) a GOLDEN RULE at the top of MINDATTIC_AGENT.md and mindattic-agent-standard/AGENTS.md: verification is build-only, tests run last, once, only on request, and orchestrators never tell subagents to run suites. | 349fa08 |
